name: Gazzew Boba U4T
description: Full-sound tactile counterpart to the Boba U4 — same nylon housing, same pronounced round bump near the top of the stroke, but without the stem-mounted silicone dampening pads, so the bottom-out and top-out ring freely. The longer-pole stem that lets the pads' seats go unused also shortens total travel versus the U4. The result is a tactile with a deep, full-bodied thud on each keypress. Popular for typists who want a strong round bump without sacrificing acoustic character. Lubed at the leaf and spring bottom; slide rails ship dry, and spring-rattling on the upstroke is common and addressed with a thin oil on the spring.
